meta.title: The Story — Mark Cooke, BEng (Hons)
meta.description: The perspective and forty-five-year arc behind Mark Cooke's aviation practice.

sections.label: A point of view built over four decades
sections.quote: In aviation, the asset is <t>never just the aircraft.</t>
body: Its condition, maintenance history, technical records, contractual obligations, commercial position and transition requirements have to be understood together. A discrepancy in a maintenance record is rarely only a technical question—it moves value, triggers obligations and decides disputes.
Mark’s work sits at that intersection: establishing what the aircraft and its records actually show, then explaining what that means for the contract and for the asset.
That perspective comes from having done the work. He has held the licence, signed the release to service, run the hangar and built the organisation.

sections.label: Three expressions of his authority
sections.title: One body of experience. Applied wherever aircraft condition carries consequence.

cards.title: Aircraft and engine condition
cards.for: Establishing the airworthiness, maintenance and records position of an aircraft or engine—and what the documentation genuinely supports.

cards.title: Leases, transitions and asset value
cards.for: Understanding how contractual obligations, redelivery conditions and technical reality meet during a transition—and where value is gained or lost.

cards.title: Disputes and evidence
cards.for: Independent analysis and written reports for counsel—explaining technical and commercial aviation evidence to lawyers, arbitrators and tribunals.

sections.label: The arc of the work
sections.title: Forty-five years spent on the aircraft, <t>then on the business around it.</t>

days.title: Airframe technician
days.body: Ten years across several Royal Air Force bases in the United Kingdom, on the maintenance and rectification of both fixed and rotary wing aircraft. The decade that set the standard for everything after it.

days.title: Licensed engineer to overhaul manager
days.body: Twelve years at one of the largest maintenance facilities in Europe at the time, capable of four widebody aircraft. Inspector Supervisor and UK CAA and FAA licensed engineer, then project manager, then aircraft overhaul manager—responsible for day-to-day operations and roughly two hundred staff.

days.title: Founder and technical director
days.body: Built a consultancy serving major commercial aircraft leasing and asset-management companies, with a team of twenty consultants working transitions, pre-redelivery, pre-purchase and mid-lease audits at locations worldwide.

days.title: Founder, partner and EVP
days.body: Co-founded and built an airworthiness and engine maintenance group from scratch—a CAMO office at Manchester International Airport and an engine maintenance facility at Hawarden Airport, approved by several airworthiness authorities. The group was sold to Sabena Engineering Brussels in 2023.

days.title: Advisor and expert witness
days.body: Advisory services to the commercial aviation industry through 29 Aero Limited, together with expert witness and expert advice services following Cardiff University Bond Solon certification in 2024.
